title: feat(shop_operations): append-only shop-operation record keyed to CNC-PS job_id (SHOP-OP-RECORD-001)
intent: First slice of the operating-loop seam named by SHOP-OPERATING-LOOP-RECOVERY-001 (#462): a durable, append-only record of operations performed on a CNC-Production-Shop job, holding only operation identity/status, measured duration and provenance, material quantity/unit, separate evidence/readiness references and human completion. Owner GO 2026-10-26 after #462 merged.
behavior_change: None at runtime. New library package app/shop_operations with no route, no router-manifest entry, no client, no migration and no importer outside its own tests. Grants no CAM or manufacturing authority; never writes manufacturing_state.

diff_articulation.what_changed: New domain package app/shop_operations (record, repository, serialization, errors), its tests, and a design record under docs/investigations/shop-op-record-001/.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The audit found no persisted per-operation record keyed to a job in any scoped repo (SOL-D09, SOL-E10 MISSING). The op-keyed RMOS JobLogService (SOL-D03) is uncalled, keyed to saw execution artifacts, and has no human-completion, provenance or supersede semantics; the saw-lab job-log (SOL-D02) is saw-only.
